Forecast hierarchy, access permissions, quotas, configuration and drilldowns.

capabilities.foundly_current: Owned stages and opportunities, permission-filtered period forecasts with separate currencies and explicit unknown values, revision-bound immutable snapshots with restart and replay protection. Managed owner quotas now bind exact periods and currency to persisted forecasts. Overlap denial, missing-data nulls, target revision conflicts, encrypted restart and current source ACL on snapshot read/export are tested. Explicit source-revision-bound probability scenarios and immutable scenario snapshots now pass exact rounding, currency/null semantics, owner isolation, read-only HTTP queries and encrypted restart. Sales scenarios now accept separately typed probability, amount in integer minor units, and valid close-date assumptions against exact current opportunity revisions. Existing source opportunities are never changed. Explicit dates move authorized open opportunities into or out of the selected period, including initially outside-period sources; missing amount/currency/probability remains literal and never becomes a complete projection implicitly. Currency totals, exact explicit-probability rounding, missing-data uncertainty, zero amounts, period boundaries, invalid input, source ownership/capabilities, stale revisions and immutable snapshot replay/rollback/restart are tested. Snapshot access also checks additional scenario-only source records; unused selection candidates are not retained in snapshots. Actual production controls support typed assumptions, current candidate scope with owner/pipeline filters, separate snapshot confirmation, stable lost-response retry and changed/detached response refusal. Actual authenticated HTTP fixtures preserve encrypted snapshots and untouched source records. No live provider, actual browser, accounting revenue or measured competitive superiority is inferred. Phase 24 continues with forecast hierarchy and remaining recorded Sales execution and other module gaps. Sales forecast hierarchy now uses explicitly assigned, immutable hierarchy versions with one root, bounded depth, no cycles and no duplicate owner assignment. Current owner-subtree queries reuse the native forecast and currency/target contracts without granting source access or claiming an organization-wide total. Shared hierarchy readers see only their currently authorized opportunities. Root/child selection, version authoring and separate node-bound native snapshot confirmation have actual UI/native service and real-member HTTP evidence, including lost-response replay, stale/detached result rejection, encrypted restart, generic-write denial and role revocation during request-body waits. Exact node/definition/current source binding protects snapshots; malformed optional scenario/hierarchy values and corrupted stored definitions fail closed. Backend hierarchy-scoped scenarios are supported; the hierarchy UI currently exposes forecast/query and snapshot workflows. CI 117 passed the preceding amount/date scenario checkpoint. Phase 24 remains active. The next Sales pipeline-board gap includes an isolated reproduced defect: a title-only edit reset a recorded probability from 0.9 to the pipeline stage default 0.2; that code defect is recorded for immediate correction, not waived. Remaining sequence/communication and other module gaps, actual browser/live-provider/production and measured competitive gates remain open.
capabilities.gap: Hierarchy authoring/query/snapshot and amount/date assumptions are evidenced. Hierarchy-scoped scenario controls, interactive pipeline board and the reproduced title-only probability reset defect remain code work. Quotas retain exact owner/period/currency scope without proration or pipeline targets; browser and measured competitive acceptance remain unproven.
capabilities.required_change: Fix the isolated title-only probability reset, complete typed board/sequence communication workflows and hierarchy-scoped scenario controls with current rights and exact snapshot source binding.
